close_reason: fixed: MailBackend::create_object doc comment documents placeholder sentinel contract
description: MemoryBackend.create_object replaces id=='placeholder' and blobId=='placeholder-blob' string sentinels with UUIDs. This contract is implicit: only the MemoryBackend source documents it. The MailBackend trait doc says 'backend replaces blobId' but does not specify the sentinel value. A backend implementor copying MemoryBackend as a template must infer the convention; a backend that uses 'placeholder' for legitimate reasons has silent data corruption. Maintenance consequence: any change to the sentinel strings in email.rs or identity.rs requires a matching change in MemoryBackend and any other backend — no compile-time link.
title: MemoryBackend 'placeholder'/'placeholder-blob' sentinel coupling
